mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to scrape. Each mode reads ONE of the input lists below -- see each field's description for which. ACTOR modes (read "Bluesky accounts"): profile, posts, followers, follows, lists, starter-packs. POST modes (read "Post URLs"): post-detail, post-likes, post-reposts, post-quotes. SEARCH modes (read "Search queries"): search-posts, search-users. FEED mode (reads "Feed / list URLs"): feed. DISCOVERY modes (need no input at all): trends, popular-feeds.
enumTitles: Starter packs -- packs an account created
Post detail -- a post plus its reply thread
Post likes -- who liked a post
Post reposts -- who reposted a post
Post quotes -- posts quoting a post
Feed -- posts from a custom feed or list
Trends -- what is trending right now

actors.title: Bluesky accounts
actors.description: Used by the ACTOR modes (profile, posts, followers, follows, lists, starter-packs). Accepts a handle (bsky.app), an @handle, a DID (did:plc:...), or a profile URL (https://bsky.app/profile/bsky.app) -- mixed freely.

postUrls.title: Post URLs
postUrls.description: Used by the POST modes (post-detail, post-likes, post-reposts, post-quotes). Accepts a bsky.app post URL (https://bsky.app/profile/<handle>/post/<rkey>) or a raw at:// URI.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Used by the SEARCH modes (search-posts, search-users). One dataset page set per query. Bluesky's inline operators work inside the query text too (for example: from:bsky.app "release notes").

feedUrls.title: Feed / list URLs
feedUrls.description: Used by the "feed" mode. Accepts a custom-feed URL (https://bsky.app/profile/<did>/feed/<rkey>), a list URL (https://bsky.app/profile/<did>/lists/<rkey>), or the equivalent at:// URI. Feeds and lists are told apart automatically.

maxItems.title: Max items per input
maxItems.description: Upper bound on records collected for EACH input item (each account, post, or query) -- not for the run as a whole. Pagination stops early when the account or result set runs out.

postFilter.title: Post type filter
postFilter.description: "posts" mode only -- which of the account's posts to return. Default (posts_with_replies) returns everything.

includePins.title: Include pinned post
includePins.description: "posts" mode only -- put the account's pinned post at the top of its feed.

threadDepth.title: Reply thread depth
threadDepth.description: "post-detail" mode only -- how many reply levels below the post to walk. 0 returns the post alone; 6 is the bsky.app web default. Replies come back flat with a replyDepth field, so the tree is still reconstructable.

parentHeight.title: Parent thread height
parentHeight.description: "post-detail" mode only -- how many ancestor posts above the given post to include. 0 (default) treats the given post as the root.

sort.title: Search sort order
sort.description: "search-posts" mode only -- rank results by engagement (top) or recency (latest).

since.title: Search: posted after
since.description: "search-posts" mode only -- only posts created at or after this time. ISO 8601 (2026-08-01T00:00:00Z) or a plain date (2026-08-01).

until.title: Search: posted before
until.description: "search-posts" mode only -- only posts created before this time. ISO 8601 (2026-08-29T00:00:00Z) or a plain date (2026-08-29).

lang.title: Search: language
lang.description: "search-posts" mode only -- restrict to posts tagged with this BCP-47 language code, e.g. id, en, ja.

author.title: Search: author
author.description: "search-posts" mode only -- restrict to posts written by this handle or DID.

mentions.title: Search: mentions account
mentions.description: "search-posts" mode only -- restrict to posts that mention this handle or DID.

domain.title: Search: links to domain
domain.description: "search-posts" mode only -- restrict to posts linking to this domain, e.g. nytimes.com.

url.title: Search: links to URL
url.description: "search-posts" mode only -- restrict to posts linking to this exact URL.

tag.title: Search: hashtags
tag.description: "search-posts" mode only -- restrict to posts carrying every one of these hashtags. Enter them without the leading # sign.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many input items to process in parallel. Ignored for "search-posts", which is forced to 1 because Bluesky throttles that endpoint per IP and parallel workers only drain the same budget faster.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Bluesky's public API has no WAF, so most modes need no proxy at all. "search-posts" is the exception: it is rate-limited per IP, and a proxy lets the actor rotate to a fresh IP instead of waiting out the cooldown.
